test_title: PYST 36: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A family of seven minors and some adults has an average wheat consumption of 11.10 kg. The average consumption for minors is 5.5 kg per person, and for adults, it is 16 kg per person. Find the number of adults in the family.
solution:
**Given:**

The family has 7 minors and some adults.

Average wheat consumption of the entire family = 11.10 kg

Average wheat consumption for minors = 5.5 kg per person

Average wheat consumption for adults = 16 kg per person

**Calculation:**

Let the number of adults = x.

Total number of family members = 7 (minors) + x (adults) = 7 + x

Total wheat consumption = (7 × 5.5) + (x × 16)

Average wheat consumption = 11.10

⇒ dfrac{(7 times 5.5) + (x times 16)}{7 + x} = 11.10

⇒ dfrac{38.5 + 16x}{7 + x} = 11.10

⇒ 38.5 + 16x = 11.10 × (7 + x)

⇒ 38.5 + 16x = 77.7 + 11.10x

⇒ 16x - 11.10x = 77.7 - 38.5

⇒ 4.9x = 39.2

⇒ x = dfrac{39.2}{4.9}

⇒ x = 8

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
